mn47:2.1: vīmaṃsakena bhikkhave bhikkhunā parassa cetopariyāyaṃ ajānantena tathāgate samannesanā kātabbā ‘sammāsambuddho vā no vā’ iti viññāṇāyāti.
mn47:3.1: “bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante dhammā bhagavaṃnettikā bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā. sādhu vata bhante bhagavantaṃ yeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho. bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.”
mn47:3.2: tena hi bhikkhave suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmīti.
mn47:3.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn47:4.1: vīmaṃsakena bhikkhave bhikkhunā parassa cetopariyāyaṃ ajānantena dvīsu dhammesu tathāgato samannesitabbo: cakkhusotaviññeyyesu dhammesu –
mn47:4.2: ye saṅkiliṭṭhā cakkhusotaviññeyyā dhammā, saṃvijjanti vā te tathāgatassa no vā’ti.
mn47:4.4: ye saṅkiliṭṭhā cakkhusotaviññeyyā dhammā, na te tathāgatassa saṃvijjantī’ti. (1)
mn47:5.2: ye saṅkiliṭṭhā cakkhusotaviññeyyā dhammā, na te tathāgatassa saṃvijjantīti. tato naṃ uttariṃ samannesati:
mn47:5.3: ye vītimissā cakkhusotaviññeyyā dhammā, saṃvijjanti vā te tathāgatassa no vā’ti.
mn47:5.5: ye vītimissā cakkhusotaviññeyyā dhammā, na te tathāgatassa saṃvijjantī ti. (2)
mn47:6.2: ye vītimissā cakkhusotaviññeyyā dhammā, na te tathāgatassa saṃvijjantīti. tato naṃ uttariṃ samannesati:

mn47:6.5: ye vodātā cakkhusotaviññeyyā dhammā, saṃvijjanti te tathāgatassāti. (3)
mn47:7.2: ye vodātā cakkhusotaviññeyyā dhammā, saṃvijjanti te tathāgatassāti. tato naṃ uttariṃ samannesati:
mn47:7.3: dīgharattaṃ samāpanno ayamāyasmā imaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ, udāhu ittarasamāpannoti.
mn47:7.5: dīgharattaṃ samāpanno ayamāyasmā imaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ, nāyamāyasmā ittarasamāpannoti. (4)
mn47:8.2: dīgharattaṃ samāpanno ayamāyasmā imaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ, nāyamāyasmā ittarasamāpannoti. tato naṃ uttariṃ samannesati:
mn47:8.3: ñattajjhāpanno ayamāyasmā bhikkhu yasampatto, saṃvijjantassa idhekacce ādīnavāti.
mn47:8.4: “na tāva bhikkhave bhikkhuno idhekacce ādīnavā saṃvijjanti yāva na ñattajjhāpanno hoti yasampatto.
mn47:8.5: yato ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ñattajjhāpanno hoti yasampatto, athassa idhekacce ādīnavā saṃvijjanti.”
mn47:8.7: ñattajjhāpanno ayamāyasmā bhikkhu yasampatto, nāssa idhekacce ādīnavā saṃvijjantī’ti. (5)
mn47:9.2: ñattajjhāpanno ayamāyasmā bhikkhu yasampatto, nāssa idhekacce ādīnavā saṃvijjantīti tato naṃ uttariṃ samannesati:
mn47:9.4: vītarāgattā kāme na sevati khayā rāgassāti.
mn47:9.7: vītarāgattā kāme na sevati khayā rāgassāti. (6)
mn47:10.1: tañce bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ pare evaṃ puccheyyuṃ:
mn47:10.2: “ke panāyasmato ākārā ke anvayā yenāyasmā evaṃ vadeti:
mn47:10.4: vītarāgattā kāme na sevati khayā rāgassā”ti.
mn47:10.5: sammā byākaramāno bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ byākareyya:
mn47:10.6: tathā hi pana ayamāyasmā saṅghe vā viharanto eko vā viharanto, ye ca tattha sugatā, ye ca tattha duggatā, ye ca tattha gaṇamanusāsanti, ye ca idhekacce āmisesu sandissanti, ye ca idhekacce āmisena anupalittā, nāyamāyasmā taṃ tena avajānāti.
mn47:10.7: sammukhā kho pana me taṃ bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
mn47:10.8: “abhayūparatohamasmi, nāhamasmi bhayūparato, vītarāgattā kāme na sevāmi khayā rāgassā”ti.

mn47:14.1: evaṃ vādiṃ kho bhikkhave satthāraṃ arahati sāvako upasaṅkamituṃ dhammasavaṇāya.
mn47:14.2: tassa satthā dhammaṃ deseti uttaruttariṃ paṇītapaṇītaṃ kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgaṃ.
mn47:14.3: yathā yathā kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno satthā dhammaṃ deseti uttaruttariṃ paṇītapaṇītaṃ kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgaṃ, tathā tathā so tasmiṃ dhamme abhiññāya idhekaccaṃ dhammaṃ dhammesu niṭṭhaṃ gacchati, satthari pasīdati:
mn47:14.4: sammāsambuddho bhagavā, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo, supaṭipanno saṅghoti.
mn47:15.1: tañca bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ pare evaṃ puccheyyuṃ:

mn47:15.5: idhāhaṃ āvuso yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃ dhammasavaṇāya.
mn47:15.6: tassa me bhagavā dhammaṃ deseti uttaruttariṃ paṇītapaṇītaṃ kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgaṃ.
mn47:15.7: yathā yathā me āvuso bhagavā dhammaṃ deseti uttaruttariṃ paṇītapaṇītaṃ kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgaṃ, tathā tathāhaṃ tasmiṃ dhamme abhiññāya idhekaccaṃ dhammaṃ dhammesu niṭṭhamagamaṃ, satthari pasīdiṃ:
mn47:15.8: sammāsambuddho bhagavā, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo, supaṭipanno saṅgho’ti.
mn47:16.1: yassa kassaci bhikkhave imehi ākārehi imehi padehi imehi byañjanehi tathāgate saddhā niviṭṭhā hoti mūlajātā patiṭṭhitā, ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ākāravatī saddhā dassanamūlikā
mn47:16.2: daḷhā, asaṃhāriyā samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.
mn47:16.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave tathāgate dhammasamannesanā hoti.
mn47:16.6: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
